summary: JetBrains is czech software company, founded in 2002. About 168 employees (Wikidata). Revenue Czech koruna 15.1 billion (2024). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 20 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 1 about acquisitions; 1 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

culture.text: Describes its Amsterdam hub as a flexible hybrid workplace with wellbeing amenities, mobility and insurance allowances and language learning.
Runs an internal Innovation Hub where small autonomous teams build new products.

open.text: JetBrains N.V. and JetBrains Expo B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Relocation support depends on the role.

growth.text: Its Prague-based company made CZK 15.1 billion revenue and CZK 2.5 billion net profit in 2024.
Launched Air, an open system for AI-assisted (agentic) software development.

worth_knowing.text: Attackers breached JetBrains' own systems through an unpatched TeamCity server and took AWS credentials.
Is taking steps to bring its fast-growing AI spending under control.
